answer: A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The oasis schedule is applied in spiral and beacon shows each instalment. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 960 identities would post 3824 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
